evals.prompt: Use these 6 phone screenshots to generate App Store promo images. Create Chinese and English versions, keep the screenshot order, and export one PNG per screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Creates 12 platform-neutral phone-outline promotional PNGs under app-store-assets/generated with zh-Hans and en folders, plus a copy.md table with short titles, subtitles, and focus/callout assumptions.

evals.prompt: I have 5 iPhone screenshots and 4 iPad screenshots. Fill them into the same templates as the examples, generate Chinese, English, and German versions.
evals.expected_output: Creates phone and pad output folders for zh-Hans, en, and de; uses generic black outline templates without branded device shells, status bars, camera cutouts, or tilted overlapping phones.

evals.prompt: Just give me the main title and subtitle for these 7 app screenshots in Chinese and English. Do not render images yet.
evals.expected_output: Returns a concise copy table only, with one title and subtitle per screenshot for zh-Hans and en, preserving screenshot order.

evals.prompt: Create the normal phone promotional screenshots, and also create 2in1 promotional screenshots from the screenshots in the 2in1 directory.
evals.expected_output: Creates the requested phone outputs plus additional 2in1 PNG/JPG/JPEG promotional images under app-store-assets/generated/harmony-agc-2in1/{locale}/. The 2in1 images are 16:9, at least 1920x1080, and under 5 MB each.
